data.name: (Debt Feeds Debt
data.detailed_description:
Your family once struck a deal with a demon: supernatural power over the market, in exchange for endless tribute. The contract is yours now.

Debt Feeds Debt is a turn-based bond market card strategy game.

Your goal
Push progress to 100 to win—or fall to −50 and lose. Progress decays every turn and ramps up over time, so passive coupons alone won’t save you.

Each turn you will

  • Spend limited cash to buy bonds with different ranks, industries, and ratings

  • Collect interest while holding; redeem principal at maturity (higher yield can mean default)

  • Advance investor orders as you buy; complete them to choose advanced cards or upgrades

  • Play basic cards to reshape the market, tweak ranks/suits, gain cash, or surge orders

  • Hit the turn’s optimal target to build FEVER combos for discounts and bonuses

What you get
Bond trading under pressure, order-driven progression, combo chains, upgradeable skills, and a race against decay—before the contract collects.
